questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Which leaf tissue contains the most chloroplasts?
questions.hint: It is the layer just below the upper surface.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Name the pores in the leaf epidermis that allow gases to diffuse in and out.
questions.hint: They are mostly on the lower surface.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Name the cells that open and close the stomata.
questions.hint: There are two of them around each pore.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: What is the function of the waxy cuticle?
questions.hint: It is waterproof.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Why is the upper epidermis transparent?
options: To let light through to the mesophyll
questions.answer: To let light through to the mesophyll
questions.hint: Think about where photosynthesis mainly happens.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: What is the advantage of air spaces in the spongy mesophyll?
options: Gases diffuse quickly to and from cells
questions.answer: Gases diffuse quickly to and from cells
questions.hint: Carbon dioxide must reach the photosynthesising cells.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Which vessel in the vein brings water into the leaf?
questions.hint: The other vessel carries sugars away.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Which vessel transports sucrose and amino acids out of the leaf?
questions.hint: It is the partner of the water-carrying vessel.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Which mineral ion is needed by plants to make amino acids and proteins?
questions.hint: It contains nitrogen.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Which mineral ion is needed to make chlorophyll?
questions.hint: It sits at the centre of the chlorophyll molecule.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: A plant shows yellowing between the veins of its older leaves. Which ion is it most likely lacking?
questions.hint: Yellowing means less of the green pigment.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: A plant has stunted growth and yellow lower leaves. Which deficiency is most likely?
questions.hint: Growth needs proteins.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Why do most leaves have more stomata on the lower surface?
options: Less water is lost by evaporation
questions.answer: Less water is lost by evaporation
questions.hint: The lower surface is cooler and shaded.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: How does a large, thin leaf help photosynthesis?
options: Large area absorbs more light and short distance for diffusion
questions.answer: Large area absorbs more light and short distance for diffusion
questions.hint: Think about two features: area and thickness.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Explain how the palisade mesophyll cells are adapted for photosynthesis.
questions.hint: Consider shape, position and what they contain.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Explain why a farmer might add fertiliser containing nitrate to a crop, and describe what would happen without it.
questions.hint: Link nitrate to proteins and growth.

bss.topic: Constituição de 1988 e a Nova República

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Em que ano foi promulgada a atual Constituição do Brasil?
questions.hint: Ela foi promulgada no fim da década de 1980.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual é o apelido da Constituição de 1988, por causa da ampliação de direitos?
questions.hint: O apelido destaca os direitos das pessoas.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Como se chama o período da história do Brasil iniciado em 1985, com o fim do regime militar?
questions.hint: O nome indica um recomeço da república.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual órgão elaborou a Constituição de 1988?
questions.hint: Foi um conjunto de parlamentares eleitos para essa tarefa.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Pela Constituição de 1988, o voto é facultativo para jovens de qual idade?
questions.hint: São jovens que ainda não atingiram a maioridade.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Para qual destes grupos a Constituição de 1988 garantiu o voto facultativo?
questions.hint: Pense em quem, por muito tempo, foi excluído do voto por não ter estudado.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Segundo a Constituição de 1988, o racismo é crime:
questions.hint: A Constituição deu tratamento muito rigoroso a esse crime.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual sistema público de saúde foi previsto pela Constituição de 1988?
questions.hint: É um sistema único e universal.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual destes é um direito social listado na Constituição de 1988?
questions.hint: Pense em algo garantido a todos para uma vida digna.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Em que ano ocorreu a primeira eleição direta para presidente após o regime militar?
questions.hint: Foi um ano depois da nova Constituição.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: O primeiro presidente eleito diretamente na Nova República sofreu um processo de impeachment em que ano?
questions.hint: Ocorreu no início dos anos 1990.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: No plebiscito de 1993, os eleitores escolheram:
questions.hint: O sistema de governo atual foi mantido.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual plano econômico de 1994 criou a moeda real e controlou a inflação?
questions.hint: O nome do plano é o mesmo da moeda.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual destes itens é uma cláusula pétrea, que não pode ser abolida por emenda?
options: Cor da bandeira de cada estado
questions.hint: Pense na divisão entre Executivo, Legislativo e Judiciário.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Explique por que a Constituição de 1988 representou uma ruptura com o período do regime militar.
questions.hint: Compare liberdades e direitos antes e depois.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Analise um desafio enfrentado pelos primeiros governos civis da Nova República.
questions.hint: Pense na economia dos anos 1980 e início dos 1990.

bus.topic: Organisation structure: charts, span of control and chain of command

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: What does an organisation chart show?
options: The structure and relationships of roles in a business
questions.answer: The structure and relationships of roles in a business
questions.hint: It is a diagram of who is who.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: What term describes the number of subordinates directly controlled by one manager?
questions.hint: Think of how far one manager's control 'spans'.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: What term describes the line of authority through which instructions pass from the top to the bottom of a business?
questions.hint: Think of links joining one level to the next.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: What is the term for giving a subordinate the authority to carry out a task?
questions.hint: The manager passes on authority but keeps responsibility.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: A business with many levels of management is described as having a:
questions.hint: Imagine the shape of the chart.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: A flat structure usually has:
options: Few levels and wide spans of control
questions.answer: Few levels and wide spans of control
questions.hint: Flat is the opposite of tall.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Which is an advantage of a narrow span of control?
questions.hint: Fewer workers per manager.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Which is a disadvantage of a long chain of command?
options: Messages can be slow and distorted
questions.answer: Messages can be slow and distorted
questions.hint: Think of a message passed through many people.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: A manager directly supervises 6 supervisors, and each supervisor manages 8 workers. How many workers are there in total under the supervisors?
questions.hint: Multiply the number of supervisors by their span.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: A business has a managing director, 4 department managers and 5 workers under each manager. How many levels of hierarchy are there?
questions.hint: Count the layers from top to bottom.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Which statement about delegation is correct?
options: The manager remains responsible for the result
Only directors can be delegated to
questions.answer: The manager remains responsible for the result
questions.hint: Authority is passed down, but accountability stays.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Which is a benefit of delegation for employees?
questions.hint: Being trusted with a task can feel rewarding.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: A firm removes a layer of middle managers. This is called:
questions.hint: The word describes removing a layer.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Which is a likely result of delayering?
questions.hint: Remaining managers take on more people.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Explain one advantage and one disadvantage for a business of having a wide span of control.
questions.hint: Consider cost and supervision.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: A growing café chain is considering moving from a flat to a tall structure. Discuss whether this is a good decision.
questions.hint: Weigh communication, control and cost, then give a judgement.
